subject: reasoning
question:
Select the cube that can be formed by folding the given sheet along the lines. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7a3228083b98fe46aea742a1b6676753bebb8aa15fbf0807e6889b0d0b6cb5f.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/12751504e30ed4c356ea4fb7d9592b55b659f9960c9fc1e8fbe7e15a1a694cce.png]
solution:
The faces opposite to each other are shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5cda536c12592c7f4a40f3ec84f448114da64186464987e9366fe0161091ae3.png] 

⇒ As the alternate positions becomes opposite to each other and the remaining two faces becomes opposite to each other.

So, opposite pairs are:

 
• 1 → 5
 
• 2 → 6
 
• 3 → 4

Therefore, according to the question :

 
• Given figure A → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef7342fe53a25eae570570c70ee5edd4e0d657d73accee39747d6e8d4f2f6e40.png] 
 
• ⇒ Can be formed as a cube from the given sheet (As 2,5 and 3 are one of the numbers of each opposite pairs)
 
• Given figure B → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/12867c4a21289537c54ca638d32b0c4e4b61060e6b2325b81bee06fa3d7e0435.png] 
 
• ​⇒ Cannot be formed as a cube from the given sheet (As 5 is opposite to 1)
 
• Given figure C → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e929579fe01f6846dd360a47628ec59a19178dd96909f305bed666fdbcad1d57.png] ​
 
• ⇒ Cannot be formed as a cube from the given sheet (As 2 is opposite to 6)
 
• Given figure D → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c9aa2cdd44fac7302603725593eeacf7128300f90ebe490ed9e527481b0e1ca.png] 
 
• ​⇒ Cannot be formed as a cube from the given sheet (As 5 is opposite to 1)

​Here, Only figure A can be formed as a cube from the given sheet.

Hence, "Only A" is the correct answer.
